en.headline: ZA Bank to take new Causeway Bay headquarters at Lee Garden Eight
en.dek: The virtual bank will occupy about 45,000 square feet across four floors of Tower 3, with a move planned in 2027, Hysan and the lender said.
body: Digital lender ZA Bank will set up a new headquarters at Hysan Development’s Lee Garden Eight in Causeway Bay, taking about 45,000 square feet across four upper floors of Tower 3, the landlord and the bank said on Wednesday.

The offices are scheduled to open in 2027. Lee Garden Eight, a joint development by Hysan and Chinachem Group of about 1.1 million square feet, is due to be completed in the fourth quarter of this year. ZA Bank’s chief executive, Ng Chung-hon, said the bank had been profitable after six years, with more than one million users, and that the move from Cyberport would bring staff together as headcount grows from about 400 to 500 people.

Hysan’s executive director and chief operating officer, Ricky Lui, said the group has been courting fintech and other digital-economy tenants for the new towers. He said occupancy across the Lee Gardens portfolio remained above 90 per cent at mid-year, and that the new complex already had a double-digit office take-up rate. A covered walkway linking the project to Causeway Bay MTR is due to open with the buildings.

zh.headline: 眾安銀行承租利園八期四層作新總部
zh.dek: 虛擬銀行ZA Bank將租用銅鑼灣利園八期3座約4.5萬平方呎寫字樓，料2027年啟用，遷離數碼港。
body: 數字銀行眾安銀行（ZA Bank）周三宣布，將承租希慎興業旗下銅鑼灣利園八期3座四層寫字樓，面積合共約4.5萬平方呎，作為新總部。
新辦公室預計2027年啟用。利園八期由希慎與華懋集團共同發展，總樓面約110萬平方呎，預期今年第四季竣工。眾安銀行行政總裁吳忠豪表示，銀行開業六年已錄得盈利，用戶超過100萬，現時員工約400至500人，辦公室將由數碼港遷往銅鑼灣以整合辦公地點。
希慎執行董事兼首席營運總監呂幹威表示，集團正吸引金融科技及其他新經濟租戶進駐新大樓。他指利園區組合出租率年中仍維持九成以上，八期寫字樓出租率已達雙位數。連接項目與銅鑼灣港鐵站的有蓋行人通道將與大樓同步落成。
